Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Excess = 9.0 km, which is 45.00% of optimal. Both gates pass: more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal. The excess also exceeds the 8.0 km materiality threshold, so this is a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is engaged. Trace integrity (POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02840 carries 228 fixes at a 10 s interval with 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0. None of limbs (a)-(c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone, no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. Driver-profile check (POL-RD-06). On EV-DPROF-02840, deviation_flags_90d = 0 and completed_trips_90d = 278. Neither limb of the pattern test is met (0 is not 3 or more; 0/278 = 0.000 is not 0.05 or more). No pattern is established, so the POL-RD-06(b) FULL_REFUND uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral are unavailable. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. The driver's traffic assertion. The driver's account ('Heavy traffic') names no advisory and cites no evidence ID. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested only against the traffic advisory for this trip, and EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). No comparison can be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the asserting party named no advisory identifier, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered and the request that this case be escalated is rejected on that ground. No other exculpatory route is open: POL-RD-04 (no chat messages; EV-CHAT-02840 has 0), POL-RD-05 (no amended endpoints; amended_optimal_distance_km is null), POL-RD-12 (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL), POL-RD-11 (fare_model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE). The remedy (POL-RD-02). fare_model is METERED. charged_total = 51.38 (EV-FARE-02840). The surge multiplier 1.4 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and nowhere else. Recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 20.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.4) + 0.80 platform fee = (26.08 x 1.4) + 0.80 = 36.512 + 0.80 = 37.312. Refund = 51.38 - 37.312 = 14.068, rounded UP to SGD 14.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 27.38% of charged_total, short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.10. The SGD 25.00 the rider contests is not supported by the policy's arithmetic. Nothing is added or netted (POL-RD-09). No ERP gantries, zero tolls, no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so there is no pass-through or billing-integrity correction and no POL-RD-09(4) referral. No driver compensation under POL-RD-04: distance_charged_km (29.0) equals the trace distance, so there are no unbilled kilometres. Confidence is 0.90, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02840, EV-TRIP-02840, EV-FARE-02840). The refund of SGD 14.10 exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the amount is issued but held for human release rather than executed automatically; that holding is procedural and does not change the ruling. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
To both parties. This is a rider-filed route-deviation claim on trip TRP-02840 (Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd to Blk 503 Bishan St 11, 5 Sep 2026, RYDE_X), billed SGD 51.38. DEVIATION. All three artifacts carry the same trip id (TRP-02840) and the same pickup instant, so the rider's identity limb is met and the excess is shown. The governing trace figure (EV-GPS-02840, cited as POL-RD-01 requires in place of the rounded trip-record copy) is 29.0 km against the booked optimal of 20.0 km (EV-TRIP-02840): an excess of 9.0 km, or 45.0%. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass (more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal), and at 9.0 km the deviation is additionally MATERIAL (greater than 8.0 km). The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 228 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m, so the excess stands on the trace and no independent corroboration is needed. No exculpatory clause is open to the driver: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02840) holds zero messages, so there is no rider-requested detour to weigh under POL-RD-04; pickup and dropoff were never amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02. THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver's answer is 'heavy traffic'. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run at all, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver's own assertion names no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) applies: the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not the cited-and-missing artifact that POL-RD-10(5) escalates on, and the deviation stands at the measured figure with the refund computed against the booked optimal route. I have considered and REJECTED the driver's argument that POL-RD-10(5) compels escalation to a human reviewer: the driver cites no advisory as exculpatory evidence (the driver's side concedes POL-RD-03 cannot run), and merely naming the identifier of an absent artifact while arguing about its absence does not turn a gap into the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes. No POL-RD-10 trigger fired, and the trace itself is unimpaired, so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged either. REMEDY (arithmetic, not discretionary). Charged total: SGD 51.38. Recomputed optimal-route fare: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 20.0 km + 0.28 x 26.0 min) x 1.4 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 37.312, the surge multiplier 1.4 being read from EV-FARE-02840.surge_multiplier and nowhere else. Refund: 51.38 - 37.312 = SGD 14.068, rounded UP to SGD 14.10. That is well above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 27.4% of the charge, far short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.10. The SGD 25.00 the rider pleaded is not supported by the policy's own arithmetic; SGD 14.10 is the ceiling on what this ruling can move. NO_ACTION would have been party-relative here and would have left the rider carrying the whole charge. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was run because the deviation is material, and it clears the driver: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 278, so no pattern is established, the FULL_REFUND uplift is unavailable, and there is no driver-conduct referral. Nothing is added to or netted against that figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, zero tolls, a zero off-route ERP total and no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09(4) discloses no billing-integrity defect and no separate pass-through correction issues; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding off-route ERP on top of a POL-RD-02 refund in any event. No driver compensation is due under POL-RD-04: the distance billed (29.0 km) equals the trace distance, so there are no unbilled kilometres. The monetary effect (SGD 14.10) is above the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed and is held for release. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
